title: LudusMCP ludus_cli_execute command injection via command/args arguments (CVE-2026-19047)
summary: LudusMCP (npm: ludus-mcp) up to and including 1.0.24 is vulnerable to command injection: executeArbitraryCommand/executeCommand in src/ludusMCP/cliWrapper.ts (component ludus_cli_execute) passes the attacker-influenced command/args arguments into a shell, so a poisoned tool call can execute arbitrary commands on the local host. The maintainer was notified via a public issue but no fixed release exists as of 2026-08-06.
